description: Guide a student through validating a time-series momentum signal on SPY with rigorous train/test methodology — from exploratory data analysis, through signal formalization and evaluation, to proper in-sample / out-of-sample separation and overfitting assessment.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: I want to build a momentum strategy on SPY. I've heard that stocks that went up recently tend to keep going up. But how do I know if this actually works, or if I'm just fooling myself with past data? Can you help me test this properly?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I'm building a time-series momentum signal on SPY — something like ROCP(20) or trailing returns. I want to do this rigorously with proper train/test separation to avoid overfitting. Can you walk me through the full validation workflow?
student_openings.advanced_quant: I need to validate a time-series momentum factor on SPY with proper IS/OOS methodology. The pipeline should be: EDA, signal formalization, IC analysis, walk-forward or fixed-split backtest, and robustness assessment. I want to quantify how much the signal degrades out-of-sample.

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Student performs exploratory analysis, formalizes a momentum signal, evaluates it with IC/quantile metrics, implements a proper train/test split backtest, reports separate IS and OOS metrics, and discusses robustness and overfitting.
required_capabilities: Perform exploratory data analysis on market data
Evaluate signal quality with IC or quantile analysis
Report separate in-sample and out-of-sample metrics
